translation.personalWelcome:
🌟 Welcome to the Holons i/o Test Network! 🌟

A *holon* is an entity that is simultaneously a whole and a part of something greater.
*I'm a holon. You're a holon.*
Your group, community, or team is a holon.
And we're all part of a great holon that Bucky Fuller called *"Spaceship Earth"!*

The *Holons Bot* helps individuals and groups to:

• Manifest their unique purpose
• Connect and collaborate
• Share resources
• Realise their inter-dependence — from local to global

---

✨ Get Started

If you haven't already, open a direct chat with *@HolonsBot* to access your personal *me-holon* and dashboard.
Here, you can manage tasks across all of your *we-holons*.

Join the *@HolonicDAO* community chat to:

• Connect with others
• Learn what's possible
• Give feedback
• Get updates and opportunities to get involved

*Bring Your Parts – Join the Evolution!*

---

⚙️ Quick Start

1. Type `/` to see all available commands
2. Type `/settings` to configure your preferences
3. Type `/dashboard` to access your web dashboard

---

🎯 Core Commands

• `/task` – Create a new task (e.g. `/task do the dishes`)
• `/tasks` – Review the task list
• `/appreciate` – Send appreciation (e.g. `/appreciate @laura for the garden`)
• `/status` – View community rankings
• `/checklists` – Create and review checklists
• `/buy` – Add to the shopping list
• `/shopping` – Review the shopping list
• `/offer` – Share what you can offer (e.g. `/offer yoga sessions`)
• `/request` – Make a request (e.g. `/request foot massage`)
• `/board` – See all requests and offers

---

💰 Value Tracking

• `/spent` – Log expenses (e.g. `/spent 10 euros shopping`)
• `/balance` – View community balance

---

⚠️ Disclaimer

This technology currently operates in a *pre-release test environment*.

*Please note:*

• This environment is *experimental* and may evolve rapidly.
• Data entered may be lost without warning and cannot be recovered.
• All inputs are stored in a *public ledger*, visible to others.
  This is intentional, fostering *trust, transparency, and shared accountability*.
• *Do not* enter personal, sensitive, or confidential information.
• By interacting with the Holons Bot, *you agree to these conditions*.

translation.moreMessage:
*🔄 Task Management*
• `/tasks` - List all currently open tasks
• `/actions` - View history of completed tasks

*👥 Community Roles*
• `/assignroles` - Automatically assign roles based on actions
• `/facilitate` - Get advice on community issues

*🛒 Shopping & Expenses*
• `/buy` - Add items to shopping list (e.g. /buy milk)
• `/shopping` - View clickable shopping list
• `/spent` - Log expenses
• `/balance` - View balance table

*💰 Currencies*
• `/addcurrencies` - Add accepted currencies (e.g. /addcurrencies euro, dollar)

*🌙 Lunation & Activities*
• `/prompt` - See current lunation day and suggested team activity
• `/bigtalk` - Engage in community-building conversations

*💫 Values & Identity*
• `/ivalue` - Set your personal values
• `/values` - View shared values of users or community

*🏷️ Content Management*
• `/tag` - Save content under specific tags
• `/publish` - Share content in the holosphere (set your hex in settings)
• `/cast` - Share content across all scales
• `/summarize` - Create conversation summaries (use /done to finish)

*🔄 Federation Tools*
• `/spoon` - Connect chats to share actions and needs
• `/fork` - Disconnect federated chats
• `/reset` - Reset community settings

Type `/` to see all available commands.
